description: This file defines a React component for displaying and managing detailed information about a team, including overview, members, permissions, and settings in a web application. It handles data fetching, state management, form handling, and user interactions for viewing and editing team data.

methods.name: fetchTeamInfo
methods.description: Fetches and sets the team info data from the backend API.

methods.name: fetchOrganization
methods.description: Fetches organization data based on team data if organization_id is present.

methods.name: getOrganizationModels
methods.description: Determines the list of models to display based on organization and user models.

methods.name: fetchMcpAccessGroups
methods.description: Retrieves MCP access groups from backend entity.

methods.name: handleMemberCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new team member via API call and updates state.

methods.name: handleMemberUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing team member's details via API call and updates state.

methods.name: handleMemberDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a team member, opening confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Confirms and performs the team member deletion through API call.

methods.name: handleDeleteCancel
methods.description: Cancels the delete operation, closing confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleTeamUpdate
methods.description: Submits updated team info to the backend API after form submission.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies specified text to clipboard and shows visual feedback.
